hero.title: Condition Based Monitoring
hero.tagline: Decision intelligence at scale to unlock the latent potential of each plant
pillars: AI agents enable decision intelligence at scale

architecture.alt: Predictive maintenance architecture: tri-axial vibration sensors on fans, extruders, compressors, blowers, pumps and motors send data over Wi-Fi to routers, then over 4G to the I/O Sense Digitization Suite, which feeds the Faclon I/O Sense Platform for fault analysis, alerts, visualisation, diagnostic reports and KPI dashboards

analytics.d: Checks every reading before it is analysed, so alerts are not raised on bad data.
Breaks each vibration signal into its frequencies, where specific faults leave a recognisable signature.
Learns each machine's normal behaviour and flags when it starts to drift.
Estimates how long a component can keep running, so work can be planned around production.

benefits.d: Machines stay available for longer, freeing up production capacity.
Early detection cuts downtime, maintenance spend and production losses.
Faults are fixed before they turn into expensive repairs and lost production.
Remote monitoring removes the need for walk-around readings next to running machines.
Automated data collection and AI analysis free engineers from manual readings.

faults: Drive motors overheating or burning out

features.d: Detected anomalies are automatically analysed, generating issue descriptions, severity classification, and recommended corrective actions (e.g., alignment check, bearing inspection, lubrication, balancing). This helps maintenance teams quickly identify root causes and take targeted action.
features.alt: I/O Sense Monitoring Locations screen listing assets by risk level, with faults found and recommended solutions for a crusher drive end and a gearbox input stage

features.d: The system performs continuous FFT spectrum analysis, harmonic detection, envelope analysis, and trend monitoring to identify vibration signatures associated with imbalance, misalignment, looseness, bearing defects, gear wear, cavitation, resonance, and other mechanical faults.
features.alt: I/O Sense asset timeline showing idle, normal and critical states through the day with FFT captures, and an axial acceleration FFT spectrum

specs: Wi-Fi (up to 80 m), Bluetooth, Modbus RS-485
